title: E-commerce Orders & Inventory Reservation
summary: Amazon-style order flow: atomic multi-SKU stock reservation, an order state machine, payment and refunds through a gateway, cancellation rules, and no overselling.
hints: Merge duplicate SKUs in the order request first (`A×2, A×1` becomes `A×3`), then validate everything, then reserve everything under one inventory lock.
Stock is deducted on placement (a reservation), and returned only when an order is cancelled.
Order lifecycle: CREATED → PAID → SHIPPED → DELIVERED. Cancel is allowed from CREATED (release stock) and PAID (release stock + refund).
A failed charge leaves the order CREATED, so the customer can retry payment.
